== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] freshly-ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* ¾ tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 ½ tsp dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* ¼ tsp mesquite smoke powder
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|flank steak]]
* Dijon [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine salt, pepper, cayenne, rosemary, and smoke powder. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steak liberally with Dijon mustard. Apply seasoning mixture and gently rub into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Heat a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] with a chimney starter (not that solvent stuff). Reapply the grate and place the steak on top. Cook, flipping once, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare.
#Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] as thinly as humanly possible across the grain. Serve warm.

steps.text: Combine salt, pepper, cayenne, rosemary, and smoke powder. Set aside.
Brush steak liberally with Dijon mustard. Apply seasoning mixture and gently rub into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a charcoal grill with a chimney starter (not that solvent stuff). Reapply the grate and place the steak on top. Cook, flipping once, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare.
Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Slice as thinly as humanly possible across the grain. Serve warm.
